name: FB 002
pageDna: A funny family page that compares family life in the old days with family life now. One specific contrast per post. Interesting and funny. Never a lecture about kids these days.
pillars: family dinner then vs phones at the table now
one house phone vs everyone on a smartphone
playing outside until streetlights vs staying inside
getting lost and asking a stranger vs GPS
handwritten notes and landlines vs group chats
emotions: I forgot we used to do that
imageStyle: One photorealistic American family photo matching the then-vs-now contrast, either an old-days home scene or a nowadays home scene, natural light, plus a short readable summary of the post on the image, no split screen, no collage, no watermark, no logo
